Find me 5 weekend trek options near Pune with difficulty and cost
6:21 PM

Here are 5 good picks, and November is a great month for them. Costs are rough guides for a group trek including transport and food, not live prices.

Trek	Difficulty	Time	Rough cost
Sinhagad	Easy	2 to 3 hours	₹200 to ₹500
Lohagad and Visapur	Easy	3 to 4 hours	₹800 to ₹1,500
Rajmachi	Easy to moderate	5 to 6 hours	₹1,000 to ₹1,800
Kalsubai	Moderate	4 to 5 hours up and down	₹1,200 to ₹2,500
Harishchandragad	Moderate to hard	Overnight	₹1,800 to ₹3,500

Going on your own is at the low end of each range. Group operators are at the high end. Kalsubai and Harishchandragad are best as overnight trips, and they get crowded on Sat 14 Nov.

Want me to look up current group trek prices for Sat 14 Nov?

Only easy treks please
6:22 PM

Only two of those five are truly easy, and both are good ones. Costs are rough guides, not live prices.

Trek	Difficulty	Time	Rough cost
Sinhagad	Easy	2 to 3 hours	₹200 to ₹500
Lohagad and Visapur	Easy	3 to 4 hours	₹800 to ₹1,500

Rajmachi is easy to moderate, so it is the next step up if you want a longer day. Want me to look for more easy treks near Pune?
